messages:
Chloe Martin: getting pings from VantaHealth again — streaming chat stalls mid-answer (SSE stays open, no chunks). anyone around to sanity check if this is back?
Avery Johnson: is this us-east only?
Chloe Martin: yep us-east, started ~20m ago. they say first token ok then nothing until their 60s idle timeout.
incident-bot: Created incident INC-2025-11-03-07 (severity: Sev2)
Ethan Park: reminds me of buffering path. do they send Accept-Encoding: gzip?
Chloe Martin: they do (node fetch defaults).
Avery Johnson: gateway config in us-east still has the x-accel-buffering=no patch?
Kimberly Park: checking nginx conf now. i see a recent change in the gzip block that might be re-enabling proxy_buffering :/
Ethan Park: can we hotfix the streaming location to force no buffering regardless of gzip?
Kimberly Park: yes, rolling config now.
Chloe Martin: i'll tell customer to retry in ~15m.
